segments.source: Paul, Isor laga ekjon noukar, Jisu Khrista laga apostle, aru Isor pora basi luwa khan laga biswas nimite aru hosa gyaan thaka juntu ki bhal ase etu logote ekta ase,
segments.reference: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,
segments.hypothesis: Paul, a servant of God, an apostle of Jesus Christ, and of the chosen by God, and a knowledge which is in the faith of the faith and of God;

segments.source: anonto jibon te asha rakhi thaka, juntu Isor, kun kitia bhi misa nokoi, yug shuru nakora age pora kosom rakhidise.
segments.reference: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;
segments.hypothesis: having hope in eternal life, which God, who doesn't call a liar, has also made the beginning of this ageless.

segments.source: Aru thik homoi te, Tai laga kotha prokahit kori dise, amikhan laga Tran-Korta Isor laga hukum pora moike kori bole hukum dise.
segments.reference: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,
segments.hypothesis: at the proper time, he revealed his word to me, as a command for God to do it,

segments.source: Titus ke, amikhan laga biswas te thaka ekjon asol chokra; amikhan laga Baba Isor, Tran-Korta Jisu Khrista te anugrah aru shanti hoi thakibi.
segments.reference: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.
segments.hypothesis: To Titus, indeed, the true son of our faith. The Father, be grace and peace in Christ Jesus.

segments.source: Moi etu karone tumike Crete majuli te chari jaise, ki kaam thik nohoi kene thakise eitu khan thik kori bole, aru moi tumike kowa nisena, sheher te girja laga rokhiya kori bole bura khan ke basi lobi.
segments.reference: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—
segments.hypothesis: For this cause I have left you in Crete, that you should do what is not right, and I said to you, 'Defrag the assembly,'

segments.source: Aru bura khan to golti nathaka hobo lage, aru ekjon maiki laga mota hobo lage, aru tai laga bacha khan bhi adat biya aru kotha namana eneka nohobo lage.
segments.reference: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.
segments.hypothesis: The elders ought to be unclothed, and to be a husband of a wife, and her children should not have been disfigated or disobedience.

segments.source: Kelemane ekjon girja laga cholawta to Isor laga ghor sa karone eku napuncha nathakibo lage. Aru tai ekjon nijor khushi te jai thaka, aru joldi khong kora, aru misa kotha, aru jhagara kora, aru lalchi nohobo lage.
segments.reference: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;
segments.hypothesis: For the prince of the assembly must not have any lack of anything except for the sake of God's house, in that he is angry, and in a matter of reproach, and of wrath,

segments.source: Kintu tai alohi manu ke tai laga ghor te rakhibo para hobo lage, dhorjo kora, sidha mon thaka, pobitro thaka, nijorke rukhabole para hobo lage.
segments.reference: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,
segments.hypothesis: but he would have kept the bed, whether he could find rest, whether it was in him, whether in sincerece the right, the holy heart, and in subjection,

segments.source: Tai hosa biswas kotha ke thik dhori thaka, aru manu ke Isor laga kotha to bhal pora bujhai dibo para, kotha namana khan ke thik rasta dikha bo para hobo lage.
segments.reference: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.
segments.hypothesis: He has rightly reported reported reported word to a man without reverence, enventing to reproving the disobedience of faith.

segments.source: Kelemane, bisi Yehudi biswasi manu khan ase, kunkhan kotha bhi namane, aru sunnot laga kotha te eku motlob nathaka kotha koi aru dusra ke thogai thake.
segments.reference: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
segments.hypothesis: For many are of the Jews who are of faith in speech and in the circumcision there are disobedience,

segments.source: Eitu khan ke rukhai dibole dorkar ase. Taikhan sorom kamai lobo nimite ghor-ghor ke sikhai thake.
segments.reference: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.
segments.hypothesis: It's necessary to deny it. They will learn to take a bed to take shame.

segments.source: Taikhan majot te ekjon bhabobadi asele kun pora koi rakhise, “Creta laga manu to sob misa koi thake, aru dusto janwar aru alsi kha-kuwa khan ase.”
segments.reference: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”
segments.hypothesis: There was a prophet who said, "The man of the flocks is a liar, and the unclean beasts and the eat of the unclean things."

segments.source: Etu gawahi hosa ase, karone taikhan ke kara pora koi thakibi, taikhan biswas te thik thaki bole nimite,
segments.reference: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
segments.hypothesis: This witnesses is faithful, that they may be called kara, that those who are appointed in faith may be established in faith,

segments.source: aru taikhan ke Yehudi laga kotha khisa khan aru hosa ke namani kene ghuri juwa khan laga piche jabo nadibi.
segments.reference: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
segments.hypothesis: and let them not go after the rest of the nations, nor after the truth,

segments.source: Mon sapha thaka khan nimite hoile sob bostu to sapha ase, kintu sapha nathaka aru biswas nakora khan nimite hoile eku bhi sapha nai, kintu taikhan laga dimag aru bhabona te bhi sob letera ase.
segments.reference: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
segments.hypothesis: For the sake of the pure in the heart are pure, but to the undefiled, and to the unbelievers are anything clean, but also to the mind and the reason they are defiled.

segments.source: Taikhan Isor ke jane koi, kintu kaam te hoile taike namane. Taikhan ke to ghin kori bole lage aru taikhan kotha namana khan ase aru eku bhal kaam kori bole thik nohoi.
segments.reference: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
segments.hypothesis: They know God, but in works it is not appropriate. They are enemies, and have no disobedience, but have done good.

segments.source: Kintu tumi to hoile, ki kotha koi, etu hosa hisab te sikhai di thakibi.
segments.reference: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,
segments.hypothesis: But you, because you are, teach the things which are spoken in the truth.

segments.source: Bura manu khan ke gusa nauthi bole, bhal bhabona kori bole, nijorke nomro kori bole, biswas te thaki bole, morom kori bole, aru dhorjo pora thaki bole sikhai dibi.
segments.reference: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,
segments.hypothesis: To the Gentiles, to be housing, having a good conscience, to live in faith, to love, and to live patiently.

segments.source: Etu nisena dangor umor thaka mahila khan ke bhi pobitro jibon laga bhal niyom thakibo nimite sikhabi, misa kotha kowa aru draikha ros piya nohobo lage, etu bodli, ki bhal ase etu dusra khan ke hikai thaki bole sikhai dibi.
segments.reference: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,
segments.hypothesis: In the same way, you have a great conscience to have a commandment of the holy life, not to drink wine or drink wine, which is good, instructed in the embortion,

segments.source: Etu nisena jawan mahila khan ke tai laga mota aru bacha ke kineka morom koribo lage, etu sikhai dibi,
segments.reference: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,
segments.hypothesis: In the same way, wives, love her husband and her children,

segments.source: bhal bhabona thaka, sapha mon thaka, nijor mota laga kotha mani thaka, sapha hoi nijor ghor kaam te bhal thaka mahila khan hobole sikhai dibi, tinehoile Isor laga pobitro kotha ke hinsa nohobo.
segments.reference: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.
segments.hypothesis: consolentiousness, sincere hearting to the husbands, teaching women in your own house with all good women, that there may be no reproach of God.

segments.source: Aru etu nisena jawan manu ke bhal kaam kori bole samjai dibi.
segments.reference: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.
segments.hypothesis: Study the young man in a hurry.

segments.source: Tumi laga sob kaam te bhal namuna he dikhai dibi. Aru tumi ki sikhai ase etu hosa aru sapha pora kowa kotha hobo lage,
segments.reference: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,
segments.hypothesis: having a good example of all things, by which you ought to be true, and whatever you hear is necessary of the truth and of your cleansing,

segments.source: juntu hosa kotha ase aru junke eku golti dibo na paribo, eneka hoile kun tumike digdar diye, taikhan sorom hobo, ki karone taikhan pora amikhan laga eku bhi biya kobo na paribo.
segments.reference: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.
segments.hypothesis: that he may be a correcting and righteous one who troubles you, for nothing is impossible that they may blaspheme.

segments.source: Sewak khan ke sob kaam te malik laga kotha mani thaki bole sikhai dibi, khushi pora aru eku jhagara nakori kene,
segments.reference: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,
segments.hypothesis: Teach the severity of the soldiers to follow masters in all things, not in strife,

segments.source: nijor malik laga eku chor nakori kene aru sob bhal kaam to biswas pora dikhai dibole nimite sikhai dibi, eneka korile bhal naam to amikhan laga Tran-korta Isor pora sikhai diya kotha ke pabo.
segments.reference: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
segments.hypothesis: as a witness of our master by faith without any means of his own master's knowledge, that a good name may be given to us by the revelation of our God,

segments.source: Kelemane Isor pora aha anugrah to sob manu laga poritran nimite ase.
segments.reference: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
segments.hypothesis: For the grace which is from God is for the salvation of all men.

segments.source: Etu amikhan ke sikhai ase, etu pora he, ki biya ase aru duniya laga itcha hisab te ase etu ke amikhan nabhabibo, aru nijorke rukhabole paribo, dharmik thakibo paribo, eneka hoile etu yug te Isor ke jana jibon thaki bole paribo,
segments.reference: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;
segments.hypothesis: We are taught, that we may not be able to deal wisely and to avoid avoid avoiding the purpose of the world, being hindered, that in this age,

segments.source: kele koile amikhan etu asis laga din nimite rukhi ase jitia sob pora dangor Isor aru Tran-korta Jisu Khrista arubi wapas ahibo.
segments.reference: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,
segments.hypothesis: for we wait for the blessed day of the glory of God and of the Savior Jesus Christ,

segments.source: Jisu he amikhan ke niyom namana paap pora udhar koribo nimite nijor jibon daan dise, aru Tai nijor nimite pobitro kori kene ekta jati bonai loise, kunkhan bhal kaam kori bole khushi kore.
segments.reference: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.
segments.hypothesis: He has given us the redemption of the law, and the land of the good works which he has made for himself to be a nation in a good work.

segments.source: Girja te etu kotha khan sikai dibi, aru manu sobke eitu khan kori bole mon dangor kori dibi, aru adhikar thaka hisab te golti kora khan ke sidha kori bhi. Kun pora bhi apuni ke hisab nathaka hobo nadibi.
segments.reference: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
segments.hypothesis: Put on this gold in the wilderness, and let it be difficult for men to do all these things, and to make sound sound sound mindless men in authority. Let no one give according to the number of your own glory.

segments.source: Girja te aha khan ke janai dibi cholawta aru dangor khan laga niche thaki bole, taikhan laga kotha mani bole, aru hodai bhal kaam nimite taiyar thaki bole,
segments.reference: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
segments.hypothesis: and make known to those who go down to the gatekeeper and to the great governors, that they may obey the voice, and always prepare for the good work,

segments.source: kunke bhi bodnam nakoribole aru jhagara nakoribole, kintu sob logote nomro aru bhal niyom pora thaki bole.
segments.reference: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
segments.hypothesis: No one can be condemned nor strife, but with every good law and good.

segments.source: Kilekoile amikhan bhi ekta somoite eku bhabona nathaka aru kotha namana thakise. Amikhan mangso laga itcha pora dhori kene harai ja khan thakise. Amikhan paap kori thakise aru dusra ke suku joli thakise. Amikhan bisi ghin thakise aru ekjon- ekjon ke bhi ghin kori thakisele.
segments.reference: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
segments.hypothesis: For we have in the same way without disobedience and disobedience, we were led astray by the flesh by the lusts of the flesh, and we have sinned and were jealous. We were hateful, and despised the flesh.

segments.source: Hoile bhi jitia Udhar-korta Isor laga morom manu uporte dikhai dise,
segments.reference: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
segments.hypothesis: But when the Lord was revealed to the beloved of the Most High,

segments.source: juntu amikhan laga kaam aru dharmikta pora nohoi, kintu Tai laga anugrah pora poritran anidise, aru Pobitro Atma dwara notun jonom aru notun jibon dise,
segments.reference: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,
segments.hypothesis: even as we were not of righteousness and of righteousness, but of his grace, being born in the Holy Spirit, and new life,

segments.source: amikhan laga Udhar-korta Jisu Khrista karone Pobitro Atma amikhan ke bhorta haali dise,
segments.reference: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;
segments.hypothesis: Our university, having received the Holy Spirit full of us for Jesus Christ,

segments.source: etu nimite Tai laga anugrah karone amikhan ke dhormik bonai kene anonto jibon laga asha te Tai laga uttoradhikari bonai dibo karone.
segments.reference: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
segments.hypothesis: that he might establish his grace to us for the sake of the eternal life, that we might be made a righteousness according to the hope of his eternal life.

segments.source: Etu kotha to biswas koribo laga ase. Aru tumikhan ke etu kotha taikhan ke jor pora koi dibole mon ase, etu pora kunkhan Isor ke biswas korise, taikhan bhal kaam te mon dikene kori thakibo nimite. Etu kotha to bhal aru sob karone labh ase.
segments.reference: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;
segments.hypothesis: This is a faithful thing. You are of adversing them of all these things, that they may be persuaded in God for a good and of all men who were able to stand.

segments.source: Kintu misa-misi kotha koi thaka, aru khandan khan khisa, aru jhagara kora, aru niyom laga kotha nimite jhagara kora sob to chari di bhi kele koile eitu khan eku labh nai.
segments.reference: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
segments.hypothesis: But there is no false speech, and the strife of the fathers, and every dispute which is by the law, and that is of the law; and that which is lacking.

segments.source: Kunba kotha namana manu ke ekbar-duibar samjai dibi, judi tai arubi kotha namanile taike alag kori dibi,
segments.reference: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,
segments.hypothesis: Give a second time to the unrighteous, a jutalelele to the lame,

segments.source: etu jani kene kun manu bhal rasta chari kene aru paap kori thake, tai nijorke bodnam kori ase.
segments.reference: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.
segments.hypothesis: knowing that he who is condemned and sins, blasphemes himself.

segments.source: Moi kitia Artemas nohoile Tychicus ke tumi logot pathabo, joldi Nicopolis sheher te ahibi, kelemane moi ta te thanda dinte thaki bole bhabona kori loise.
segments.reference: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.
segments.hypothesis: When I have sent with you some time to Nicopolis, which is by the city of Nicrob, for I have decided to stay there for the winter.

segments.source: Para tak Zenas ukil aru Apollos ke pathai dibi, taikhan eku bhi komti nohobo nimite.
segments.reference: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.
segments.hypothesis: Until Para, send nascukil and Apollos, that they may not be lacking.

segments.source: Aru biswasi khan bhi bhal kaam kori bole hiki bo lage, aru bisi ki dorkar ase, etu te modot dibo paribo nimite, aru eneka hoile eku kaam nathaka nohobo.
segments.reference: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.
segments.hypothesis: They also who are approved to be healed, and to be able to give gifts, and no dealings.

segments.source: Ami logote thaka sob pora tumike salam janai ase. Salam di ase jun manu khan biswas te amikhan ke morom kori ase. Apuni khan sob logote Isor laga anugrah thakibo dibi.
segments.reference: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
segments.hypothesis: All who are with me greet you. The God of those who believe in us. Grace to all of you.

segments.source: Paul, Jisu Khrista laga koidi, aru moi logote bhai Timothy, duijon pora Philemon ke, jun amikhan laga morom sathi aru susamachar laga prochar korate eke logote kaam kora jon ase,
segments.reference: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
segments.hypothesis: Paul, the brother of Jesus Christ, with me Timothy, who two of us, is with one who is a fellow work in the preaching of our beloved and of our Good News,

segments.source: aru biswas te amikhan laga bhoini Apphia ke, aru Archippus amikhan laga sipahi ke, aru tumi laga ghor te joma kora girja ke.
segments.reference: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
segments.hypothesis: in our faith we Apphia, and Archippus our synian, and the assembly which is in your house.

segments.source: Baba Isor aru Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anugraha aru shanti tumikhan logote thaki bole dibi.
segments.reference: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
segments.hypothesis: The God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all the grace of our God and peace,

segments.source: Moi hodai Isor ke dhanyavad di thake. Moi laga prathana te tumikhan ke yaad kori thake.
segments.reference: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,
segments.hypothesis: I always give thanks to God. I remember in my prayer,

segments.source: Tumikhan Probhu Jisu Khrista logote morom aru biswas thaka aru ekjon-ekjon logote thaka to moi hunise.
segments.reference: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,
segments.hypothesis: I heard you being kind to the Lord Jesus Christ, and to be the faithful and undefiled.

segments.source: Moi prathana kori ase tumikhan biswas pora lok kori thaka to amikhan majote Khrista dwara ki bhal ase, etu sob aru bhi bhal pora janibo paribo.
segments.reference: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.
segments.hypothesis: I pray that you may know everything that is more important than Christ, that you have them to pray.

segments.source: Tumikhan laga morom thaka nimite moi bisi khushi aru aram paise, kelemane, tumi, moi laga bhai, pora pobitro khan laga mon pora taja kori dise.
segments.reference: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
segments.hypothesis: In the multitude of joy and rest of your love, because you, my brother, have been brought up by the heart of the saints.

segments.source: Etu karone, moi Khrista laga naam pora mon dangor hoi kene tumikhan ke ki kori bole lage etu hukum dibole pare,
segments.reference: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
segments.hypothesis: Therefore I am able to make you obey in the name of Christ, and to command you concerning the things which I ought to do,

segments.source: kintu morom thaka nimite, moi tumikhan ke anurodh kori ase- Moi, Paul, ekjon bura manu aru etiya Jisu Khrista nimite ekjon koidi.
segments.reference: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
segments.hypothesis: but because I beg you, Paul, and the elders, and I speak concerning Christ Jesus.

segments.source: Moi laga bacha Onesimus ke bhabona kori kene hudi ase, moi loha laga rusi pora bandhi kene thaka homoi te tai laga baba hoi jaise.
segments.reference: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,
segments.hypothesis: I have turned his father to adoption, and was a father of his chains while I was bound with my father.

segments.source: Tai ekta homoi te tumikhan nimite eku kaam laga thaka nai, kintu etiya tai tumi aru moi nimite bisi kaam laga ase.
segments.reference: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.
segments.hypothesis: He will have no choice but today he is the least of you and of mys.

segments.source: Moi taike tumikhan logote pathai di ase, tai moi laga bisi morom kora ekjon ase.
segments.reference: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,
segments.hypothesis: I send him to you, his dear friend, is my great lover.

segments.source: Moi itcha thakise, jitia tak moi susamachar prochar kora nimite loha pora bandhi kene ase, titia tak taike moi logote rakhi kene tumikhan laga naam te moike sewa kori bole nimite.
segments.reference: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.
segments.hypothesis: I wish it were a while I was bound to preach the Good News, that he should be kept in me in your name, to serve me in the army.

segments.source: Kintu moi tumikhan ke nahudi kene eku kaam kori bole mon nai. Moi tumikhan pora bhal kaam kori thaka to hoile ene pora koribo dibole mon nai, kintu ki bhal kaam kori ase etu bhal itcha pora hobole lage.
segments.reference: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
segments.hypothesis: But I didn't dare to do anything against you. I didn

segments.source: Etu karone tai tumikhan pora olop din nimite alag hoi jaisele, aru etu pora hodai nimite taike tumi wapas pai jobole nimite.
segments.reference: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,
segments.hypothesis: So he was separated from you for a little while, and that he might receive you forever, because you were made a servant with you.

segments.source: Tai aru manu laga sewa nokorile, kintu tai ekjon sewa kora manu pora bhi bhal hoi kene morom thaka bhai hobo. Moi taike bisi morom kore, aru tumike bhi bisi morom kore, mangso pora bhi aru Probhu Jisu laga naam pora bhi.
segments.reference: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
segments.hypothesis: He will serve no more, but he will be more faithful than a servant. I love him more and more. The flesh also is in the name of the Lord Jesus.

segments.source: Jodi moi bhi tumikhan laga sathi ase koile, moike jineka tumikhan pora loise etu nisena, taike bhi loi lobi.
segments.reference: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
segments.hypothesis: If I also have any friends, even as you have, take me back.

segments.source: Kintu jodi tai tumikhan logote kiba biya korise aru dibole baki ase koile, etu moi uporte hali dibi.
segments.reference: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.
segments.hypothesis: But if he has anything against you, and if he asks you to add to me, throw it on me.

segments.source: Moi, Paul, moi laga nijor hath pora etu likhi ase. Moi nijor sob to wapas kori dibo- aru tumikhan nijorke moi logote dibole baki ase!
segments.reference: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).
segments.hypothesis: I, Paul, my own hand is written. I will repay you all, and you will present yourselves to me!

segments.source: Hoi, bhai, Probhu laga naam pora moi nimite ekta kaam kori dibi; Khrista nimite moi laga mon to taja kori dibi.
segments.reference: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
segments.hypothesis: Yes, my Lord, be a work for me, and my heart is made for Christ.

segments.source: Tumi pora kotha mani kene thaka to moi bharosa ase. Aru moi kowa kotha pora bhi tumi bisi koribo koi kene moi tumike etu chithi likhi ase.
segments.reference: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.
segments.hypothesis: I have confidence in your obedience. I have written through the word that I will do this letter to you, as you have multiplied.

segments.source: Aru etu logote, etiya moi nimite ekta kamra taiyar kori kene rakhibi, moi asha ase tumi laga prathana pora moi joldi tumi logote wapas ahibo paribo.
segments.reference: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
segments.hypothesis: And with this, let me now prepare a room, that I may come back to you quickly from your prayers.

segments.source: Epaphras, Jisu Khrista laga kaam nimite moi logote bondhi ghor te thaka sathi, tai bhi tumike salam jonai ase.
segments.reference: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
segments.hypothesis: Epaphras, I have my fellow prisoners in prison with you, who also greet you.

segments.source: Mark, Aristarach, Demas, aru Luke, moi logot kaam kori thaka khan sob pora bhi salam jonai ase.
segments.reference: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
segments.hypothesis: Mark, Aristarach, Demas, and Luke, those who work with me:

segments.source: Jisu Khrista laga anugrah tumikhan sob logot hodai thaki bole dibi. Amen.
segments.reference: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
segments.hypothesis: The grace of Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

segments.source: Kuntu shuru pora thakise- juntu moi khan hunise, aru suku pora dikhise, juntu moi khan saise, aru amikhan laga hath pora dhorise, eitu khan sob jibon laga kotha ase.
segments.reference: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life
segments.hypothesis: The one who heard the beginning saw and the eyes of which our eyes saw, and the word of our hands was with our fathers.

segments.source: Aru, etu jibon amikhan ke janibole dise, aru amikhan etu laga gawahi ase. Moi apuni khan ke anonto jibon laga kotha koi ase, jun to Baba Isor logote ase, aru etu kotha amikhan ke janibole nimite dise.
segments.reference: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);
segments.hypothesis: and, let's know this life, and we are witnesses to us. I tell you the word of eternal life, which is in God the Father, and this is for us to know.

segments.source: Amikhan ki hunise aru dikhise, etu sob apuni khan ke koidi ase, etu pora amikhan sob mili kene thakibo. Aru, amikhan Baba aru Tai laga Putro, Jisu Khrista logote milikena ase.
segments.reference: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
segments.hypothesis: That which we have heard and seen, that in all that we have together. We will be reconciled to the Father and to the Son of our Father, Jesus Christ.

segments.source: Aru, amikhan to apuni khan nimite etu kotha khan likhi ase etu pora apuni khan khushi kori thaka to pura hoi jabo nimite.
segments.reference: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.
segments.hypothesis: Let's not read this for you in the future to keep the fulfillment of your anger.

segments.source: Amikhan etu kotha Isor laga Putro Jisu Khrista logot pora hunise aru apuni khan ke koi ase: Isor to puhor ase, aru Tai logote eku andhera nai.
segments.reference: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
segments.hypothesis: This is the word which we have heard from God in Christ Jesus, and tell you, God is light, and there is no darkness in him.

segments.source: Jodi amikhan Tai logote milikena ase koi aru andhar laga rasta te berai, titia amikhan misa koi ase aru hosa laga kotha khan mani kene thaka nohoi jai.
segments.reference: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.
segments.hypothesis: If we have joined with him and walk in the ways of the darkness, we speak lies and don't keep the truth.

segments.source: Kintu jodi amikhan ujala te berai jineka Tai ujala te thake, amikhan ekjon-ekjon logote milikena ase, aru Tai laga Putro Jisu laga khun pora amikhan laga sob paap to sapha kori diye.
segments.reference: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.
segments.hypothesis: But if we walk in the light, even as he is in the air, we have together, and with the blood of the Son of Jesus, all our sins are clean.

segments.source: Jodi amikhan paap nai koi, titia amikhan nijorke thogai ase, aru hosa to moi khan logote nai.
segments.reference: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
segments.hypothesis: If we don't sin, we're just deceived; and the truth isn't with me.

segments.source: Kintu jodi amikhan pora Isor ke amikhan laga paapkhan shikar kore, titia Tai hosa thaka pora amikhan laga paapkhan maph kori dibo aru sob adharmikta pora sapha kori dibo.
segments.reference: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
segments.hypothesis: But if we confess our sins to God, he will forgive our sins and sanctified our sins by unrighteousness.

segments.source: Jodi amikhan paap kora nai koile, amikhan Taike misa bonai di ase, aru Tai laga kotha amikhan logote nai.
segments.reference: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
segments.hypothesis: If we have not sinned, we have made him false. We have not made him ours.

segments.source: Ami laga bacha khan, moi tumikhan ke etu likhi ase tumikhan paap nokorile nimite. Kintu jodi kunba paap kore, amikhan laga Baba Isor logote kotha kori diya ekjon ase, Jisu Khrista, kun dharmik ase.
segments.reference: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
segments.hypothesis: I write to you, my children, that you won't sin. But if anyone sins, he has spoken to the Father, Jesus Christ, who is righteous.

segments.source: Tai amikhan laga paap maph kori diya ekjon ase, aru khali amikhan ekla nimite nohoi, kintu pura duniya nimite.
segments.reference: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
segments.hypothesis: who forgives our sins, and not for us only, but for the whole world.

segments.source: Etu pora amikhan Taike jani loise, jodi amikhan Tai laga adesh khan mani kene thake koile.
segments.reference: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
segments.hypothesis: With this, we have known him, if we are fully obedient to his commandments.

segments.source: Kun manu koi, “Moi Isor ke jane,” kintu kotha mani kene nathake, tai misa kowa manu ase, aru tai logote hosa nai.
segments.reference: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
segments.hypothesis: He who says, "I know God," but doesn't obey. He is a liar, and doesn''t have truth.

segments.source: Kintu kun manu Isor laga kotha mane, tai logot te Isor laga morom to sob phale bhal bonai dise. Etu pora amikhan jane amikhan Tai logote ase:
segments.reference: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:
segments.hypothesis: But we know the word of God which is exalted and has made all the love of God in them, and we know that we are with him.

segments.source: kun manu tai Isor logote ase koi, Khrista jineka beraise, etu nisena tai bhi bera bole lage.
segments.reference: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.
segments.hypothesis: He who says to be in God, that the Christ also may walk, as he also walked.

segments.source: Morom laga bhai khan, moi tumikhan ke notun niyom likha nohoi, hoilebi kuntu purana niyom tumikhan logote shuru pora ase, etu he koi ase. Etu purana niyom he tumikhan huni thaka laga kotha ase.
segments.reference: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
segments.hypothesis: Beloved, I dont write to you the new law, but the old commandment which is from you is from the beginning, that you may follow. This is the law that you hear.

segments.source: Hoilebi moi tumikhan nimite notun niyom likhi di ase, juntu niyom Khrista aru tumikhan usorte hosa ase, kelemane andhera to jai ase, aru hosa laga puhor to juli ase.
segments.reference: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.
segments.hypothesis: But I wrote for you a new law of the law which is in Christ and before you, for darkness is going, and the light of the truth is a flame of light.

segments.source: Kun manu ujala te ase eneka koi, aru nijor laga bhai bhoini khan ke ghin kore, tai etiya bhi andhera te ase.
segments.reference: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.
segments.hypothesis: For he who is light says, and hates his sisters, he is still in the darkness.

segments.source: Kun manu tai laga bhai ke morom kore tai ujala te ase aru tai kitia bhi biya rasta te nagiribo.
segments.reference: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.
segments.hypothesis: He who loves his brother is in the light and will never stumble in a way.

segments.source: Kintu kun manu tai laga bhai ke ghin kore tai andhera te ase aru andhera te berai ase. Tai kote jai ase tai nijor bhi najane, kelemane andhera pora tai laga suku andha kori dise.
segments.reference: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
segments.hypothesis: But he who hates his brother in the darkness is in the dark and in the wind. Where he goes, he doesn't know himself, for the darkness has been delivered his eyes.

segments.source: Moi tumikhan ke likhi ase, morom laga bacha khan, kelemane Khrista laga naam pora tumikhan laga paap maph paise.
segments.reference: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
segments.hypothesis: I write to you, children of love, for your sins are forgiven you in the name of Christ.

segments.source: Moi apuni khan ke likhi ase, baba khan, kelemane apuni khan jane utu ekjon kun ase, jun shuru pora ase. Moi tumikhan nimite likhi ase, jawan manu khan, kelemane tumikhan biya ekjon logote jiti loise.
segments.reference: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.
segments.hypothesis: I write to you, fathers, for you know who are from the beginning, who is written for you, you younger, because you have overcome one.

segments.source: Moi tumikhan ke likhi dise, chutu bacha khan, kelemane tumikhan Baba Isor ke jane. Moi etu apuni khan ke likhise, baba khan, kelemane apuni khan jane etu ekjon ke kun shuru pora ase. Moi tumikhan ke likhise, jawan manu khan, kelemane tumikhan takot ase, aru Isor laga kotha tumikhan logote ase, aru tumikhan biya uporte jiti loise.
segments.reference: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
segments.hypothesis: I wrote to you, you little children, for you know God the Father. I wrote these, the fathers, because you know who are from the beginning. I have written to you that you are strong, and to the word of God, and you have overcome.

segments.source: Etu duniya ke morom nokoribi aru etu duniya te thaka jinis khan ke morom nokoribi. Jodi kunba manu etu duniya ke morom kore, titia tai logote Baba Isor laga morom nai.
segments.reference: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
segments.hypothesis: Don't love the world, and don't have compassion on it. If anyone loves this world, he has no Father.

segments.source: Kelemane ki to etu duniya te ase- mangso laga itcha, aru suku laga itcha, aru jibon laga phutani- etu Baba pora nohoi kintu etu duniya laga ase.
segments.reference: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.
segments.hypothesis: For whatever is in the world, the will of the flesh, the lust of the eye, and the glory of life is not of the Father, but of the world.

segments.source: Etu duniya aru tai laga itcha khan khotom hoi ase. Kintu kun manu Isor laga itcha pora thake tai hodai thakibo.
segments.reference: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
segments.hypothesis: having the desire and the world is destroyed, but he who is of God is forever.

segments.source: Chutu bacha khan, etu hekh laga homoi ase. Tumikhan Khrista bhirodhi ahi ase koi kene hunise, aru etiya to bisi Khrista bhirodhi jon ahi jaise. Etu pora amikhan jane hekh homoi to ahise.
segments.reference: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.
segments.hypothesis: For these, little children, in the present time, in hearing that you came together in Christ, being multiplied, Christs, we know that the time has come.

segments.source: Khrista ke bhirodh kora khan to amikhan pora ulaikene jaise, kintu taikhan to amikhan pora nohoi. Jodi taikhan to amikhan pora ase koile amikhan logote thaki bole asele. Kintu jitia taikhan ulaikene jaise, etu pora jani loise taikhan kun bhi amikhan pora nohoi.
segments.reference: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.
segments.hypothesis: The proud have been removed from us, but they are not from us. If they were we were here with us, they knew that no one were from us;

segments.source: Kintu tumikhan Pobitro Ekjon pora asirbad paise, aru tumikhan sob hosa jani ase.
segments.reference: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
segments.hypothesis: But you have received the Holy One, and you know the truth.

segments.source: Moi tumikhan hosa najane koi kene etu likha nai, kintu tumikhan jani ase aru hosa te eku misa nai.
segments.reference: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
segments.hypothesis: I don't write these things that you don's truth, but you know and don''t lie in the truth.

segments.source: Kun misa kowa jon ase, tai ekjon, jun pora Jisu he Khrista ase koi kene mana kore? Etu manu Khrista bhirodhi ase, kelemane tai Baba aru Putro ke mana kori ase.
segments.reference: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
segments.hypothesis: Who is a liar, who can deny Jesus Christ? He is a man of Christ, because he has denied the Father and the Son of God.

segments.source: Kun manu Jisu ke mana kore tai laga Baba nai. Kun manu Jisu ke loi, tai logote Baba ase.
segments.reference: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
segments.hypothesis: He who rejects him is not the Father. He who takes Jesus and is the Father, he has the Father who does.

segments.source: Aru tumikhan to, shuru pora ki kotha hunise etu tumikhan logote thaki bole dibi. Jodi tumikhan shuru pora ki hunise etu monte rakhe koile, tumikhan hodai Putro aru Baba logote thakibo.
segments.reference: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.
segments.hypothesis: Then let the voice of the prophets be with you, and the last things which you have heard from the beginning, you will always be with the Son and the Father.

segments.source: Etu kosom Khrista pora amikhan ke dise- anonto jibon.
segments.reference: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.
segments.hypothesis: For this promise he gave us eternal life.

segments.source: Moi etu kotha tumikhan nimite likhi ase, utu manu karone bhi kun pora tumikhan ke biya rasta te loijabo.
segments.reference: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.
segments.hypothesis: I write these things to you, even to a man who will receive you in the way of evil way.

segments.source: Aru tumikhan to, ki asirbad tumikhan Khrista pora paise etu tumikhan logote he ase, aru dusra pora tumikhan ke sikhai dibole dorkar nai. Kintu Tai laga asirbad pora ki sikhai dise etu hosa ase aru misa nohoi, aru tumikhan ke sikhai diya nisena, Tai logote thakibi.
segments.reference: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
segments.hypothesis: You are not at all the blessing which you have received from Christ, and not to teach you the same things, but in the grace of his grace, there is no truth, and no truth; as you have been taught, in him.

segments.source: Etiya, bacha khan, Tai logote thakibi, jitia Tai wapas ahibo, moi khan mon dangor koribo aru Tai aha homoi te sorom nakhabo.
segments.reference: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
segments.hypothesis: Now therefore, you children, be with him, when he comes, we will be disappointed in his coming.

segments.source: Jodi tumi jane Tai dharmik ase koi kene, titia hoile tumikhan etu bhi jani thakibo kun manu thik kaam kore tai Isor pora jonom hoise.
segments.reference: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
segments.hypothesis: If you know that he is righteous, yet you know him who is worthy to be born by God.

segments.source: Sabi Isor pora kineka morom amikhan ke dise, eneka pora amikhan Isor laga bacha ase kobole nimite, aru hosa pora bhi amikhan to Tai laga bacha khan ase. Etu karone, prithibi pora amikhan ke najane, kelemane taikhan Isor ke najane.
segments.reference: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
segments.hypothesis: See how God has given us mercy, that we should be children of God, and no, but we are children of his salvation. Therefore the earth has no knowledge of us, because they don't know God.

segments.source: Morom laga bhai khan, amikhan etiya Isor laga bacha khan ase aru amikhan ki hobo etu etiya bhi dikhai diya nai. Amikhan jane jitia Khrista ahibo, amikhan Tai nisena hoi jabo, kelemane Tai kineka ase etu nisena amikhan Taike dikhibo.
segments.reference: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.
segments.hypothesis: Beloved, we are children of God and haven't seen the things which we must be. We know that when Christ comes, we may be like him, for we will see him as he is.

segments.source: Kun manu Khrista uporte asha rakhe, Khrista sapha thaka nisena, etu manu khan bhi nijorke sapha kori loi.
segments.reference: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
segments.hypothesis: For he who hopes in Christ Jesus, as the Lord is pure, and they also cleanse themselves.

segments.source: Kun paap kaam khan kori ase tai niyom khan mani kene thaka manu nohoi, kelemane paap te niyom nai.
segments.reference: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.
segments.hypothesis: The sin that does not do according to the law, because is not guilty.

segments.source: Tumikhan jane Khrista ke dikhai diya to paapkhan hatai dibole nimite hoise, aru Tai logote eku paap nai.
segments.reference: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.
segments.hypothesis: You know that Christ was to take away the sins, and that there was no sin in him.

segments.source: Kun manu Khrista logote thake, tai aru paap kaam nakore. Aru kun manu paap kaam kore, tai Isor ke dikha nai, aru Taike janibole para nai.
segments.reference: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.
segments.hypothesis: He who lives in Christ doesnt sin, and he who works works works, didn't see God, and didn's knowledge.

segments.source: Morom laga bacha khan, kun pora bhi tumike biya rasta te loi jabole nadibi. Kun manu bhal kaam kore tai dharmik ase, Khrista dharmik thaka nisena.
segments.reference: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
segments.hypothesis: You children of love, let no one lead you into the way of evil. He who does good is righteous, even as Christ is justified.

segments.source: Kun manu paap kaam khan kore tai saitan laga ase, kelemane saitan bhi shuru pora paap kaam kori kene ahise. Etu nimite Isor laga Putro ke dikhai dise, aru Tai pora saitan laga kaam khan khotom kori dibole.
segments.reference: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
segments.hypothesis: For he who does evil is the devil, because the devil has been under the way to do the works of the devil. For this reason the Son of God has been revealed, that he should destroy the devil's work.

segments.source: Kun manu Isor pora jonom loise tai biya kaam kori kene nathake kelemane Isor laga bijon tai logote ase. Tai paap kori kene thaki bole napare kelemane tai Isor pora jonom hoise.
segments.reference: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.
segments.hypothesis: The man who was born of God didn't walk after wickedness, because the seed of God was with him. He didn's sin, because he was born from God.

segments.source: Etu pora Isor laga bacha khan aru saitan laga bacha khan ke dikhai diye: Kun manu dharmik kaam nakore tai Isor laga nohoi, aru kun manu tai nijor laga bhai ke morom nakore tai bhi Isor laga nohoi.
segments.reference: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.
segments.hypothesis: For he is a revelation to the children of God and the childrens of the devil. He who doesn't do the righteousness, is not God's, and he who loves his brother.

segments.source: Kelemane tumikhan shuru pora etu kotha huni kene ahise, amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom kori bole lage.
segments.reference: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—
segments.hypothesis: For you have heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.

segments.source: Amikhan Cain nisena nohobole lage, kun biya ekjon pora ahise aru nijor bhai ke morai dise. Ki nimite taike morai dise? Kelemane tai laga kaam khan paap laga kaam khan thakise aru tai laga bhai Abel laga kaam khan dharmik kaam khan thakise.
segments.reference: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
segments.hypothesis: Let's not be like Cain, who came from an evil one and killed his brother. Why then was there any work in the works of sin? For his brother, the work of Abel, has a righteous covenant.

segments.source: Tumikhan asurit nalagibi, ami laga bhai khan, jodi tumike etu duniya pora ghin kore.
segments.reference: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.
segments.hypothesis: Don't be astonished, my brothers, if you hate the world.

segments.source: Amikhan mora pora ulaikene jibon paise, kelemane moi khan bhai ke morom kore. Kun manu morom te nathake tai mori kene ase.
segments.reference: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.
segments.hypothesis: In death we find life, and in death, I love brotherly. He who is lacking in love is dead.

segments.source: Kun manu nijor bhai ke morom nakore tai manu morai diya manu ase. Tumi jane manu morai diya manu ke kitia bhi anonto jibon tai logote thaki bole na paribo.
segments.reference: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
segments.hypothesis: For he who doesn't love his brother is a murderer. You know that he who kills the man will never live with him.

segments.source: Etu pora amikhan morom to jane, kelemane Khrista amikhan nimite Tai laga jibon dise. Amikhan bhi nijor laga bhai khan nimite jibon dibole lage.
segments.reference: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
segments.hypothesis: We know that our love is made for us, because Christ also gave life to us. We also must live for our brothers.

segments.source: Kintu kun manu logote duniya laga sob saman ase, aru tai laga bhai dukh te thaka dikhile bhi, bhai nimite tai laga mon bondh kori kene rakhe, titia hoile tai logote Isor laga morom kote ase?
segments.reference: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?
segments.hypothesis: But to him who has all the things of the world, and to see his brother in distress, how much more then is his heart shut up?

segments.source: Ami laga morom bacha khan, amikhan khali kotha aru mukh pora morom nokorile, kintu kaam aru hosa pora morom koribo.
segments.reference: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
segments.hypothesis: My beloved children, we will not be gracious to mouth, but to work and truth.

segments.source: Etu pora amikhan jani loi amikhan hosa te ase, aru amikhan laga mon Isor usorte rakhi diye.
segments.reference: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,
segments.hypothesis: With this we know that we are truth, and that our hearts are set before God.

segments.source: Jodi amikhan laga mon pora amikhan ke biya ase koi, Isor to amikhan laga mon pora bhi dangor ase, aru Tai sob jinis khan jani ase.
segments.reference: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
segments.hypothesis: If our heart hates us, God is greater than our hearts, and all things know.

segments.source: Morom laga bhai khan, jodi amikhan laga nijor mon pora amikhan ke bodnam nadiye, titia amikhan Isor uporte bharosa ase.
segments.reference: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;
segments.hypothesis: Beloved, if our hearts dont reject us, we are confident in God.

segments.source: Amikhan ki mange etu pai jabo, kelemane amikhan Tai laga kotha mani kene thake aru Tai ki khushi pai eitu khan kore.
segments.reference: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
segments.hypothesis: We will pay what we ask, for we obey him, and we do all that he pleases.

segments.source: Etu Tai laga kotha khan ase: amikhan Tai laga Putro Jisu Khrista ke biswas koribo aru ekjon-ekjon ke morom koribo, Tai pora etu kotha amikhan ke diya nisena.
segments.reference: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.
segments.hypothesis: This is his word: we believe in Jesus Christ, and have affection for one another, even as it was from him.

segments.source: Tai laga kotha mani kene thaka manu to Tai logot thake, aru Tai bhi taikhan logote ase. Tai amikhan logote ase koi kene jane Atma dwara jane, junke Tai pora amikhan nimite dise.
segments.reference: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
segments.hypothesis: The man of his own flesh is with him, and he is with them, knowing that the Spirit is with us, through whom he has given to us.

segments.source: Morom laga bhai khan, sob atma ke biswas nokoribi. Kintu, kuntu atma Isor pora ase etu bhal pora sai lobi, kelemane bisi misa bhabobadi khan prithibi te ulaikene ase.
segments.reference: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
segments.hypothesis: Let loves not believe in all the souls; but in the good of the Spirit the things which are from God, for many false prophets are coming to the earth.

segments.source: Etu pora tumikhan Isor laga Atma to janibo- kun manu Jisu Khrista to sharir hoi kene Isor pora ahise koi kene shikar kore,
segments.reference: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,
segments.hypothesis: that you may know the Spirit of God, who teaches the Christ from the dead and that the Lord is from the body,

segments.source: aru kun atma pora Jisu to Isor pora ahise koi kene shikar nakore. Etu Khrista bhirodh kora laga atma ase, jun ahibole ase koi kene tumikhan hunise, aru etiya tai prithibi te ahi jaise.
segments.reference: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.
segments.hypothesis: and didn't confess with the spirit that Jesus was from God. The spirit of the man who was called by the spirit is spirit of God, and you have heard that he was to come into the earth.

segments.source: Tumikhan Isor pora ase, morom laga bacha khan, aru taikhan ke jiti loise, kelemane etu ekjon kun tumi logote ase Tai etu duniya te thaka ekjon pora bhi sobse dangor ase.
segments.reference: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
segments.hypothesis: You are of God, the children of love, and have overcome them, for this one who is with you is greater than he who is in the world.

segments.source: Taikhan duniya laga ase; etu nimite taikhan ki koi etu duniya laga he ase, aru duniya laga manu khan taikhan laga kotha he hune.
segments.reference: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.
segments.hypothesis: They are the world's, and the things that are of the world, and these hear their words.

segments.source: Amikhan Isor pora ase. Kun manu Isor ke jane amikhan laga kotha hune. Aru kun manu Isor pora nohoi amikhan laga kotha nahune. Etu pora amikhan jane hosa laga atma aru misa laga atma.
segments.reference: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
segments.hypothesis: We are from God. We know that the word of God is heard. Not everyone who hears from God is of us, but by him we know the spirit of truth and the spirits of falsehood.

segments.source: Morom laga bhai khan, amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom koribo, kelemane morom to Isor pora he ahe, aru kun manu morom kore tai Isor pora jonom loise, kelemane Isor to morom ase.
segments.reference: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
segments.hypothesis: Let love, brothers, we love one another, for love comes by God, and he who loves God, because God is gracious.

segments.source: Kun manu morom kori bole najane tai Isor ke najane, kelemane Isor to morom ase.
segments.reference: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
segments.hypothesis: He who is void of loving kindness doesn't know God, for God is gracious.

segments.source: Kelemane Isor laga etu morom amikhan ke dikhai diya nimite, Isor pora Tai laga ekjon morom thaka Putro ke duniya te pathai dise aru etu pora moi khan sob Tai logote jinda hoi jabo.
segments.reference: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
segments.hypothesis: For he has granted to us his beloved Son, that we may live with him.

segments.source: Etu laga morom to, amikhan pora Isor ke morom kora karone nohoi, kintu Tai pora amikhan ke morom korise, aru Tai amikhan ke Tai laga Putro pathaise amikhan ke paap pora bacha bole nimite.
segments.reference: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
segments.hypothesis: So then, because we loved God, we didn't keep God's love, but he loved us, and sent us to save us from sin.

segments.source: Morom laga bhai khan, jodi Isor pora amikhan ke iman morom korise, titia hoile amikhan bhi ekjon-ekjon ke morom kori bole lage.
segments.reference: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.
segments.hypothesis: Beloved, if God had loved us so much, we ought to love one another.

segments.source: Kun manu bhi Isor ke kitia bhi dikha nai. Jodi amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom kore, Isor amikhan logote thake, aru Tai laga morom to amikhan logot bhal bonai diye.
segments.reference: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
segments.hypothesis: No one has seen God. If we love one another, God lives with us, and his love heals us.

segments.source: Etu pora Isor amikhan logote ase koi kene jane, kelemane Tai laga Atma amikhan ke dise.
segments.reference: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.
segments.hypothesis: God knows that we are with him, for his Spirit has been given to us.

segments.source: Aru, amikhan dikhise aru etu laga gawahi ase Baba pora Tai laga Putro ke etu duniya laga Tran-korta hobole pathaise.
segments.reference: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.
segments.hypothesis: We saw and were witnesses of that the Father sent out to his Son that he should be a Savior of the world.

segments.source: Kun manu nijor laga mukh pora shikar kore Jisu he Isor laga Putro ase koi kene, Isor tai logote ase aru tai bhi Isor logote ase.
segments.reference: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.
segments.hypothesis: For everyone who confesses his own mouth is the Son of God, and is with him and with God.

segments.source: Aru, Isor pora amikhan ke morom kora to janise aru biswas korise. Isor to morom ase, aru kun manu etu morom te thake tai Isor logote ase, aru Isor bhi tai logote ase.
segments.reference: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
segments.hypothesis: God, being merciful to us, believed. God is kind, and he who is in love, and God with him.

segments.source: Etu nimite, morom to amikhan laga majote bhal bonai dise, etu pora amikhan bisar kora laga dinte bharosa kori kene thakibo, kelemane Khrista thaka nisena, amikhan bhi etu duniya te thaki ase.
segments.reference: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.
segments.hypothesis: For this cause, being commended among us, lets hold boldness in the day of judgment, as our world also in Christ.

segments.source: Morom te eku bhoi nai. Kintu, hosa morom pora sob bhoi phelai diye, kelemane bhoi to sajai pabole nimite ase. Kintu kun manu bhoi kore, morom to tai logote nai.
segments.reference: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
segments.hypothesis: There is nothing in love, but fears all things from the truth, for fear is that those who fear fear it may be counted to judgment; but he is not with him.

segments.source: Amikhan morom kore kelemane Isor pora poila amikhan ke morom korise.
segments.reference: We love him, because he first loved us.
segments.hypothesis: We love love him, because God loved us first.

segments.source: Jodi kunba manu koi, “Moi Isor ke morom kore,” kintu nijor laga bhai ke ghin kore, tai misa koi ase. Kun manu tai laga nijor bhai ke morom nakore, kun tai dikhise, Isor ke kitia bhi morom kori bole na paribo, kunke tai dikha nai.
segments.reference: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
segments.hypothesis: If anyone says, "I love God," but he who hates his brother is a liar. He who doesn't love his brother, he can't see God's love.

segments.source: Aru, etu he sikhai diya kotha ase kun to amikhan Khrista nimite rakhise, kun manu Isor ke morom kore tai nijor laga bhai ke bhi morom kori bole lage.
segments.reference: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.
segments.hypothesis: This is the doctrine which we have learned, that he who loved God loves his brother should also love.

segments.source: Kun manu Jisu he Khrista ase koi kene biswas kore tai Isor pora jonom loise, aru kun manu Isor ke morom kore, Tai jonom kora bacha ke bhi morom kore.
segments.reference: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.
segments.hypothesis: He who believes in him is Christ, who loves God, loves the son of him who loves him.

segments.source: Etu pora jane amikhan Isor laga bacha khan ke morom kore, jitia amikhan Isor ke morom kore aru Tai laga hukum khan ke mane.
segments.reference: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.
segments.hypothesis: We know that God's children loved by his God when we loved him and keep his commandments.

segments.source: Kelemane etu he Isor nimite morom ase: amikhan Tai laga hukum khan mani kene thaka to. Tai laga hukum khan bhari nohoi.
segments.reference: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.
segments.hypothesis: For it is beloved for God: We have kept his commandments, and not all his commandments.

segments.source: Kun manu Isor pora jonom loise tai duniya ke jiti loise. Etu pora amikhan duniya ke jiti loise, aru amikhan laga biswas bhi.
segments.reference: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.
segments.hypothesis: He who was born of God overcomes the world, and through our faith we have received the world.

segments.source: Kelemane duniya ke jiti bole para jon to dusra nohoi kintu jun pora Jisu to Isor laga Putro ase koi kene biswas kori loise.
segments.reference: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
segments.hypothesis: For the world was dismissed, but one who believes in him is the Son of God.

segments.source: Etu ekjon ase kun pani aru khun pora ahise: Jisu Khrista. Tai khali pani pora aha nai, kintu pani aru khun pora ahise. Etu Pobitro Atma pora he gawahi dise kelemane Atma to hosa ase.
segments.reference: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
segments.hypothesis: This is one of the drinks and blood, Jesus Christ, who came out of the water, and of the blood, came in, and testified. This is the Spirit, for he is truth.

segments.source: Kelemane ta te tinjon ase kun etu laga gawah ase:
segments.reference: For there are three who testify:
segments.hypothesis: For there are three who have these things:

segments.source: Atma, aru pani, aru khun. Etu tinta eke logote mili kene ase.
segments.reference: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.
segments.hypothesis: The Spirit, the waters, and the blood. The third is joined to one.

segments.source: Jodi amikhan pora manu khan laga gawahi loi, Isor laga gawahi he etu pora bhi dangor ase. Kelemane Isor laga gawahi to eneka ase, Tai pora he Tai laga Putro laga gawahi dise.
segments.reference: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.
segments.hypothesis: If we testify about the multitudes, the testimony of God is greater than this; for the witness of God has been testified about him by him the Son.

segments.source: Kun manu Isor laga Putro ke biswas kore, tai nijor laga gawahi ase. Kun manu Isor ke biswas nakore Taike misa bonai dise, kelemane tai Isor pora Tai laga Putro laga gawahi diya to biswas kora nai.
segments.reference: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.
segments.hypothesis: He who believes in the Son of God is witnessed his own. He who doesn't believe in him makes a false way, because he didn't believed the witness of his Son.

segments.source: Etu gawahi ase: Isor amikhan ke anonto jibon dise, aru etu jibon Tai laga Putro Jisu logote ase.
segments.reference: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
segments.hypothesis: This is the witness: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in Jesus, the Son of God.

segments.source: Kun manu logote Jisu ase tai jibon paise. Kintu kun manu logote Isor laga Putro Jisu nai tai jibon panai.
segments.reference: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
segments.hypothesis: He who has Jesus life has found it, but he who has no Son of God has life in him.

segments.source: Moi tumikhan ke etu kotha khan likhi ase etu pora tumikhan anonto jibon ase koi kene janibo- tumikhan kun Isor laga Putro Jisu Khrista laga naam te biswas kore.
segments.reference: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.
segments.hypothesis: I have written to you these things, that you may know that the eternal life of the Son of God, who believe in the name of Jesus Christ.

segments.source: Aru, etu bharosa amikhan Isor logote ase koi kene jane, jodi Tai laga itcha hisab te amikhan mange, Tai amikhan ke hunibo.
segments.reference: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
segments.hypothesis: Even though we know that the great disturbance is with God, we will hear of him according to the will of him who asked us,

segments.source: Aru, jodi Isor amikhan ke hune koi kene jane- amikhan Tai logote ki mangibo- Tai logote moi khan ki mangise etu sob paise koi kene jane.
segments.reference: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
segments.hypothesis: If we know that God hears us in the presence of him, we know what we ought to ask him.

segments.source: Jodi kunba manu tai laga bhai ke paap kaam kori thaka dikhe aru etu pora mora nai koile, tai prathana kori bole lage, aru Isor pora taike jibon dibo. Moi eitu khan ke koi ase kun paap kori kene mora to dikha nai. Kunba paap to mora dikhi pai; Moi etu nimite prathana kori bole lage koi kene kowa nai.
segments.reference: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.
segments.hypothesis: If anyone sees that his brother is unclean, and doesn't die, he must pray and give life to him. I say this to him who doesn's dead, and that he is not found. I don't have a sin to pray.

segments.source: Dharmik nathaka kaam khan sob paap ase, kintu kunba paap karone mora laga sajai nadiye.
segments.reference: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.
segments.hypothesis: All who are righteous are sin, but one for sin doesn't receive death.

segments.source: Amikhan jane kun manu Isor pora jonom hoise tai paap nakore. Kintu tai ekjon kun Isor pora jonom hoise taike bachai kene rakhe, aru dusto atma pora taike dukh dibole na paribo.
segments.reference: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.
segments.hypothesis: We know that there is no one who is born of God, but he who is a born of the Lord will not be able to torment him by the unclean spirits.

segments.source: Amikhan Isor pora ase koi kene jane, aru amikhan jane pura duniya to ekjon biya thaka laga sakti te ase.
segments.reference: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
segments.hypothesis: We know that God is from, and that we know that the whole world is in the power of an evil one.

segments.source: Kintu amikhan jane Isor laga Putro pora ahi kene amikhan ke gyaan dise, etu pora Tai hosa ase koi kene moi khan janibo. Aru, moi khan Tai logote ase kun hosa ase, Tai laga Putro Jisu Khrista. Etu ekjon hosa Isor aru anonto jibon ase.
segments.reference: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.
segments.hypothesis: But we know that the Son of God came and bore us wisdom, that he might know that he is honest; and we are with him who is honest, the Son Christ, the true, the eternal life.

segments.source: Bacha khan, nijorke murti puja kora khan pora bachai kene thakibi.
segments.reference: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
segments.hypothesis: Children, protect yourselves from idolatry.

segments.source: Bura manu pora basi luwa mahila aru tai laga bacha khan ke likhi ase, kunkhan ke moi hosa te morom kore- aru moi ekla nohoi, kintu sobke kun hosa janise-
segments.reference: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,
segments.hypothesis: The basin women and her children are written to those who love the truth, and I am not alone, but to all who know the truth.

segments.source: kelemane hosa to amikhan logote thaki ase aru etu hodai nimite amikhan logote thakibo.
segments.reference: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:
segments.hypothesis: for truth is in us, and it will be with us forever.

segments.source: Anugrah, daya, aru shanti Baba Isor aru Jisu Khrista laga asirbad tumikhan logote thakibi, jun Putro laga Baba ase, hosa aru morom te.
segments.reference: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
segments.hypothesis: Peace be to you, and to God the Father and the God of Christ Jesus, the Father of the Son, in love and truth.

segments.source: Moi bisi khushi kori ase etu huni kene tumikhan laga kunba bacha khan hosa laga rasta te berai ase, jineka amikhan Baba khan pora amikhan etu hukum to paise.
segments.reference: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.
segments.hypothesis: I am glad to hear that some of your sons are walking on the way of the truth, even as the Father saw the commandment.

segments.source: Etiya moi tumike anurodh kori ase, mahila- moi tumike notun hukum likhi kene dibole nimite nohoi, kintu shuru pora juntu thakise- amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom kori bole lage.
segments.reference: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
segments.hypothesis: Now I ask you, women- I dont show you a new commandment, but in the first place we ought to love each other.

segments.source: Etu morom ase, ki amikhan Tai laga hukum hisab te berai kene jabole lage. Etu hukum ase juntu shuru pora tumi hunise juntu laga rasta te tumi bera bole lage.
segments.reference: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.
segments.hypothesis: But we are beloved, whatever we ought to walk according to his commandment. This is the commandment which you have heard from the beginning, that you may walk in the ways of which you ought to obey.

segments.source: Kelemane manu khan ke thogai diya duniya te bisi jai kene ase, aru taikhan etu shikar nakore Jisu Khrista sharir hoi kene ahise. Tai thogai diya manu aru Khrista bhirodhi ase.
segments.reference: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.
segments.hypothesis: For men are multiplied in the world of deceived. They didn't confess that the Christ Jesus was flesh, the deceiver and the deceivers.

segments.source: Nijorke sai lobi, amikhan ki nimite kaam kori sele tumi etu naharabo karone, kintu etu pora tumi pura iman to pabo.
segments.reference: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
segments.hypothesis: See that you will see, for what we have worked to you, that you may not lose it, but that you should receive the fruit.

segments.source: Kun manu Jisu Khrista pora ki sikhai dise etu noloikene age jai, titia hoile tai logote Isor nai. Kun manu etu kotha khan mani kene thake, tai logote Baba aru Putro duijon bhi ase.
segments.reference: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
segments.hypothesis: For he who doesn't follow after Jesus Christ, has no God. He who keeps these things is of the Father and the Son of God.

segments.source: Kun manu tumi laga usorte ahe aru eneka nahikai, taike ghor bhitor te namati bhi aru taike salam nadibi.
segments.reference: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,
segments.hypothesis: He who comes to you and doesnt greet him in the house, and dont greet him.

segments.source: Kun taike salam diye, tai laga biya kaam khan te tai bhi bhag loijai.
segments.reference: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
segments.hypothesis: He who greets him takes some members in his wickedness.

segments.source: Moi tumikhan logote bisi kotha likhi bole ase, kintu moi kagos te aru siyahi pora etu kotha khan likhi bole mon nai. Hoilebi, moi tumikhan logote ahi kene ekjon-ekjon logote kotha kori bole mon ase, etu pora tumikhan laga khushi aru bhi bisi dangor hobo.
